# Contributing to Exo

Thanks for helping. Bug reports, ideas and clearer wording are welcome.

## Before you start

- **Report a bug or suggest a feature** in [Issues](https://github.com/UhhErix/Exo/issues/new/choose). Ask questions in [Discussions](https://github.com/UhhErix/Exo/discussions).
- **Security problems** go through [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/UhhErix/Exo/security/advisories/new), never a public issue.

## What you agree to

By contributing, you agree to license your contribution under the [MIT license](../LICENSE). Send only work you have the right to share.

## Pull requests

- Keep one change per pull request, and say what it fixes and how you checked it.
- Match the code around it: its naming, its comments and Exo's design (Exo Launcher's look is the standard).
- Words in the app are plain and short, in Exo's voice.

Pull requests are squash-merged into `main`.
